set.acceptance: TestGuidesFeedFindingsFromStdin in internal/guide/build_test.go asserts that each of the verifier, review and plan-review guide topics shows the `<<'EOF'` stdin form and that no `<file>` form of rhiza run findings or rhiza run verdict remains in them; go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes
set.statement: The verifier, review and plan-review guide topics show rhiza run findings and rhiza run verdict fed from stdin by a heredoc (`- <<'EOF'` ... `EOF`), with their existing flags (--leaf, --check, --json) and JSON shapes, so an agent records findings and verdicts without a temp file or compound shell command
